gaps.plain-private: A direct message that does not address the bot matches nothing. Turn on “Any direct message” if it should answer one-to-one chats.

overrideParts.storeUnmatched: Decide separately whether to keep unmatched messages

triggerPolicy.residual: {count, plural, =1 {# extra keyword condition is kept as it was saved and is not shown above.} other {# extra keyword conditions are kept as they were saved and are not shown above.}}

channelAllowlist.help: Platform chat or channel ids. Everything in a listed chat is answered.
channelAllowlist.label: The chat is on this list

keyword.help: Matched anywhere in the message text.
keyword.label: The message contains a keyword

privateDefault.help: Every message in a one-to-one chat, without needing to be addressed.
privateDefault.label: Any direct message

replyToBot.help: A reply to a message this bot sent counts as addressing it.
replyToBot.label: Someone replies to the bot

selfMention.help: How a person normally addresses a bot in a group.
selfMention.label: The bot is @-mentioned

slashCommand.help: Matches on the start of the text, so `/ask` also matches `/ask something`.
slashCommand.label: The message starts with a command

userAllowlist.help: Platform user ids. Anyone listed is answered wherever they write.
userAllowlist.label: The sender is on this list

triggerPolicy.rulesHelp: Any condition that matches starts a turn. With none of them on, the bot never answers.

storeUnmatched.help: On, unanswered messages stay in the inbox as history. Off, they are dropped.
storeUnmatched.label: Keep messages that match nothing

triggerPolicy.title: When to answer

warnings.channel-allowlist-empty: The chat list is on but empty, so it never matches.
warnings.channel-blocklist-empty: The blocked-chat list is on but empty, so it blocks nothing.
warnings.keyword-blocklist-empty: The blocked-word list is on but empty, so it blocks nothing.
warnings.keyword-empty: The keyword condition is on but has no keywords, so it never matches.
warnings.rate-limit-blocks-everything: A limit below 1 blocks the first message of every minute, so the bot goes silent.
warnings.slash-command-empty: The command condition is on but has no prefixes, so it never matches.
warnings.user-allowlist-empty: The sender list is on but empty, so it never matches.
warnings.user-blocklist-empty: The blocked-sender list is on but empty, so it blocks nothing.

tunnel.description: Expose this desktop's adapter webhook receiver to the public internet so Slack / Lark / Discord interactions can reach it. Uses the cloudflared `--url` quick-tunnel.
tunnel.desktopOnly: Tunnel control requires the desktop app

install.description: Run one of the following on your {platform} host, then start the tunnel.
install.title: Install cloudflared

tunnel.noRuntimeHint: A tunnel exposes a bot that is already running, and this browser is not paired with anything that runs one. Open Cognia on your desktop first.
tunnel.notInstalled: cloudflared isn't installed on this machine
tunnel.remoteHostHint: The tunnel is a process on the host that runs your bots, so it starts and stops there. A server deployment does not use one at all — it serves the same inbound URL on its own origin.
tunnel.title: Cloudflared tunnel

webhookUrls.description: Copy these into each platform's admin console once the tunnel is up.
webhookUrls.noAdapters: No adapters configured yet. Add one in the Adapters tab.
webhookUrls.notApplicable: Reverse-WebSocket transport — no public URL needed.
webhookUrls.title: Adapter webhook URLs
webhookUrls.tunnelOff: Start the tunnel above to surface a public URL.

usagePresence.badgeStale: This bot is set to publish a status badge it cannot publish, so no status is going out at all.
usagePresence.conversationHelp: Conversation key hosting the pinned usage card (e.g. lark:'<'adapterId>:'<'chatId>). The card is created on the first refresh and edited in place afterwards.
usagePresence.enableHelp: Periodically publish your local token usage (tokens, cost) to this platform — as a status badge next to your name and/or a pinned card that updates in place.
usagePresence.enableLabel: Show token usage on this platform
usagePresence.targetsHelp: Platform user ids (one per line) the status badge is applied to — e.g. Lark open_id (ou_…). Leave empty to only maintain the status text.
usagePresence.title: Usage status

wechatOa.appIdHelp: Official Account → Settings → Basic config → AppID.
wechatOa.appSecretHelp: AppSecret — used for the access token + 客服 reply API.
wechatOa.credentialUnchangedPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current value
wechatOa.credentialsRequired: App ID, App Secret, Token and EncodingAESKey are required
wechatOa.encodingAesKeyHelp: 43-character key from Server Config (safe mode) — used to decrypt callbacks.
wechatOa.quietHoursIncomplete: Quiet hours need a start, end, and timezone.
wechatOa.sectionDeliveryDesc: The callback URL WeChat posts messages to.
wechatOa.sectionIdentityDesc: Official Account credentials and safe-mode keys.
wechatOa.testCredentialScopeHelp: Testing mints a short-lived access token from WeChat to verify the AppID and AppSecret.
wechatOa.tokenHelp: The Token you set under Server Config (used for signature checks).
wechatOa.webhookUrlHelp: Prefix this path with your public base URL and paste it into Server Config → URL.
wechatOa.windowNote: Replies use the 客服 message API and are only allowed within 48h of the user's last message.

wechatPersonal.adapterCreated: WeChat connected. Replies start once a contact messages the bot.
wechatPersonal.banRiskNote: Unofficial integration via the iLink gateway. Personal-account automation may violate WeChat's terms — there is a real account-ban risk. Use a non-primary account.
wechatPersonal.confirmedNoToken: Login confirmed, but the gateway returned no bot token. Request a new QR code and try again.
wechatPersonal.desktopOnly: Personal WeChat QR login is only available in the desktop runtime.
wechatPersonal.loggedInHint: Currently logged in. Re-scan only to switch account or recover an expired session.
wechatPersonal.loginRequired: Scan and confirm the QR code before saving.
wechatPersonal.qrFailed: Failed to obtain a login QR code.
wechatPersonal.qrInstructions: Open WeChat on your phone → Scan, then confirm the login.
wechatPersonal.quietHoursIncomplete: Quiet hours requires From, To, and Timezone.
wechatPersonal.replyOnlyNote: Reply-only: the bot can only reply to people who message it first. Scheduled / workflow proactive pushes are not delivered on this channel. Sessions expire and require re-scanning the QR code.
wechatPersonal.sectionAdvancedDesc: Quiet hours and global mute for outbound replies.
wechatPersonal.sectionLoginDesc: Scan the QR code with the WeChat account you want the bot to run as.
wechatPersonal.statusExpired: QR code expired — request a new one.

wecom.adapterCreated: WeCom bot created. The long connection starts once enabled.
wecom.botIdHelp: The 智能机器人 BotID from the WeCom admin console. Stored encrypted in the OS keyring.
wecom.credentialsRequired: Bot ID and Secret are required.
wecom.preflightFailed: Could not verify the new credentials: {error}
wecom.proactiveNote: Note: WeCom only delivers proactive pushes (scheduled / workflow) to a chat after the user has messaged the bot at least once.

quickCommands.help: WeCom 智能机器人 has no persistent menu surface. We approximate one by pushing a template_card on enter_chat — each row below becomes a button. Pick a stable trigger key (you'll never see it as a user; it's only how the click is wired).

wecom.quietHoursIncomplete: Quiet hours requires From, To, and Timezone.
wecom.secretHelp: The long-connection Secret (distinct from any callback Token / EncodingAESKey). Stored encrypted in the OS keyring.
wecom.sectionAdvancedDesc: Quiet hours and global mute for outbound replies.
wecom.sectionIdentityDesc: The 智能机器人 BotID + long-connection Secret, plus an optional welcome message.
wecom.sectionQuickCommandsDesc: Buttons pushed on enter_chat as a template_card menu — each maps a trigger key to a prompt or slash command.
wecom.testCredentialScopeHelp: Testing mints a short-lived access token from WeCom to verify the corp credentials.
wecom.welcomeHelp: Sent when a user opens the bot chat (enter_chat). Leave blank to send no welcome.
wecom.welcomePlaceholder: Hi! How can I help you today?
wecom.testConflictLiveConnection: This bot already has its one WeCom connection open. Stop the bot before testing different credentials — WeCom allows only one connection per bot, and testing now would drop the live one.
